# Apple

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from apple/lang.json and apple/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//apple:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//apple:defs.bzl", "apple_ios_app", "apple_ios_app_test", "apple_ios_xcframework")
```

## Rules

### `apple_ios_app`

```python
apple_ios_app(name, library = None, frameworks = [], entry = None, srcs = None, hdrs = [], deps = None, platform = None, bundle_id = "", version = "", deployment = "", xcode_version = "", resources = [], infoplists = [], families = ["iphone"], entitlements = None, provisioning_profile = None, tags = None, testonly = False, visibility = None)
```

Builds one upstream iOS application bundle over a Rust library cell, XCFramework imports, or a Swift @main module.

### `apple_ios_app_test`

```python
apple_ios_app_test(name, app, srcs = None, deployment = "", device_type = "", os_version = "", deps = None, tags = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs XCTest cases inside one app on a declared simulator device and runtime.

### `apple_ios_xcframework`

```python
apple_ios_xcframework(name, library = None, hdrs = [], deps = None, bundle_id = "", bundle_name = "", version = "", deployment = "", xcode_version = "", platforms = [], resources = [], infoplists = [], tags = None, testonly = False, visibility = None)
```

Builds and checks one XCFramework over a Rust static library and public headers.

### `apple_ios_lib`

```python
apple_ios_lib(name, srcs = [], deps = [], proc_macro_deps = [], crate_root = None, crate_name = None, edition = None, hdrs = [], platform = None, triple = "", sdk = "", deployment = "", xcode_version = "", crate_features = [], rustc_flags = [], frameworks = [], tags = [], testonly = False, visibility = None)
```

Builds one Rust static library for one iOS device or simulator cell and checks its Mach-O.

### `apple_ios_export`

```python
apple_ios_export(name, app, visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that signs one device app into a distributable IPA.

### `apple_macos_app`

```python
apple_macos_app(name, srcs = None, hdrs = [], deps = None, library = None, frameworks = [], plugins = [], resources = [], infoplists = [], bundle_id = "", version = "", deployment = "", platform = None, xcode_version = "", entitlements = None, provisioning_profile = None, tags = None, testonly = False, visibility = None)
```

Builds one upstream macOS application over a Rust library, checked and ad hoc signed.

### `apple_macos_sign`

```python
apple_macos_sign(name, app, visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that signs one macOS app with a Developer ID.

### `apple_macos_notarize`

```python
apple_macos_notarize(name, app, visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that notarizes and staples one signed macOS app.

### `apple_provisioning`

```python
apple_provisioning(name, route = "", accept_licenses = [], allow_download = False, api_token = "", credential_file = "", deployment = "", endpoint = "", host = "", macos_version = "", sdk = "", xcode_version = "", **kwargs)
```

Validates one Apple toolchain provisioning selection; nothing builds.

### `apple_toolchain_probe`

Records the executor's real Xcode, SDK, compiler, and macOS identities, failing on any mismatch.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provisioning` | `label` | yes | The apple_provisioning selection to qualify. |
| `_ios` | `label` | no |  |
| `_macos` | `label` | no |  |
| `_probe` | `label` | no |  |
| `_simulator` | `label` | no |  |

### `apple_simulator_boot`

```python
apple_simulator_boot(name, simulator = "", visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that boots one simulator and waits for it.

### `apple_simulator_install`

```python
apple_simulator_install(name, app, simulator = "", visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that installs one built app on one simulator.

### `apple_simulator_launch`

```python
apple_simulator_launch(name, bundle_id, simulator = "", visibility = None)
```

Declares an explicit launcher that starts one installed app on one simulator.
